title: AtkinsRéalis Wins Major Rail Deals And NVIDIA AI Pact Reshapes Outlook
title_zh: AtkinsRéalis 赢得重大铁路交易，NVIDIA AI 协议重塑前景
summary: AtkinsRéalis Group (TSX:ATRL) has been awarded a major Network Rail contract to upgrade signalling and telecoms infrastructure in Southern England as part of a government backed rail modernization program.
summary_zh: 作为政府支持的铁路现代化计划的一部分，AtkinsRéalis Group（多伦多证券交易所股票代码：ATRL）已获得一份重要的网络铁路合同，用于升级英格兰南部的信号和电信基础设施。

title: As Claude Deals Yet Another Blow, Here’s Why HP and Intel Are the Lowest-Rated IT Stocks to Buy
